# aeneid-088 — drafter's notes (XI.648–724)

29 units, 77 lines; `t` cut by `A.cut` in `make_units.py`; all script checks pass with no warnings.
Every unit is at most five lines and ends at punctuation. Part name "Camilla in the Thick of Battle
(XI.648–724)"; Latin title "Camilla bellatrix. Dolus Liguris". One Greenough paragraph (648); `p` on unit 648.

## Speech marks
- Camilla to Ornytus: opens 686 (unit 686), closes 689 (unit 688, `Camillae.”`).
- The Ligurian (son of Aunus): opens 705 mid-line after `incipit haec:` (unit 705), closes 708 (unit 706).
- Camilla to the Ligurian: opens 715 (no lead-in verb; `haec fatur virgo` follows at 718), closes at the end of
  717, `Auno,”`. Checked: the speech really ends at 717; the closing mark after the comma is the archive's
  ordinary placement where Greenough's sentence runs on (same pattern elsewhere in the source). Not a misprint.
- l and i carry “ ” exactly where t does. EXEMPT = {} (empty). No rule-5b misprints of marks in this part.

## Misprints / doubtful readings
- No misprint under rule 5b.
- Greenough's own inconsistencies, kept and noted: `securem` (656) vs `securim` (696); `volnere` (669) vs
  `vulnus` (698).
- Latin Library variants of sense, noted in n: 671 `suffuso` for `suffosso` (unit 670; Greenough kept);
  688 `redargueret` for `redarguerit` (unit 687; shade of tense only). Spellings (`derigit`, `Clytio`,
  `Chromim`, `quadripedemque`, `accinge`, `accensa`, `securim`, `uulnere`, `si quando`) noted only as spellings
  where a note mentions the form, never as variants.
- 679–680 `pugnatori`: construed with `cui` (the hunter turned fighter), the alternative (with `iuvenco`,
  "fighting bullock") mentioned. 682 `agrestis`: both acc. pl. with `manus` and nom. with `sparus` given.
- 711 `interrita`: taken as nominative (short final a by the metre), with Camilla.
- 702 `pugnae` taken as dative of separation with `evadere`.

## Scansion (for scan-fixes.json; not touched here)
- 659 `Threiciae` = Thrē-ĭ-cĭ-ae, four syllables: quālēs | Thrēĭcĭ | ae cūm | flūmĭnă | Thērmō | dōntĭs
  (the scanner's COSTLY flag).
- 667 `abiete`: consonantal i, ăb-jĕ-tĕ with first syllable long by position: ādvēr | sī lōn | gā trāns |
  vērbĕrăt | ābjĕtĕ | pēctŭs. Worth a hand check.
- 711 `puraque interrita`: rāqu(e) īn | tērrĭtă (short final a).
